reviewer.evidence:
All 12 family/shared slices were independently read for meaning, register, script, technical terms, and unintended English prose. An AST-based source review confirmed full key coverage, default-key order within every slice, placeholder multisets, and the locale’s CLDR plural-category set. The scaffold report was also used for untranslated-entry discovery and syntax parsing. No tests, builds, typechecks, or gates were run. Corrections: Corrected JSON tool “arguments” that had been translated as “reasons”; restored the colon in a field label; clarified resolved prompt preview and query-operator wording. Removed an extra parenthesis in the neighbor-group label, corrected vCard Home, and restored Jupyter’s literal In [n] execution markers. Terminology uncertainties: AI vocabulary such as “prompt”, “embedding”, “schema”, “token” and “argument” uses conventional technical borrowings/transliterations; local product terminology may vary. Not claimed; this is an AI-assisted independent semantic review. Allowlist has 38 message paths with per-path rationales. Native-speaker certification is not claimed. Terminology uncertainties: AI vocabulary such as “prompt”, “embedding”, “schema”, “token” and “argument” uses conventional technical borrowings/transliterations; local product terminology may vary. Updated 2026-09-28: an independent AI-assisted review checked all 69 added messages for meaning, UI register, terminology and placeholders, and corrected the catalog before this snapshot. The research-source count was checked against the pinned CLDR categories, including locale-specific decimal and non-singular forms. The complete 1,384-key snapshot was checked for key coverage, value kinds, placeholders and exact-English message paths; only individually justified new cognates, loanwords and technical names were retained. This increment does not claim a new linguistic review of all older messages, human review or native-speaker certification.
